notes.title: UMeFate Update V0.0.7 Pre-Alpha Tech Demo
notes.content:
[b]Added:[/b]

- Feedback and bug report system
- Integration of feedback and bug report system with discord
- Few more furnitures
- Splitting for optimisation main menu from game runtime
- Adding furnitures samples
- Player controlled UMe has circular indicator, to see where the player is


[b]Changes:[/b]
- Ingame UI framework
- New main menu room
- New main menu UI system
- Main menu camera behaviour
- Improving ingame camera movement
-  Wall construction elevation plane, can be now set at desired altitude, using pointer (mouse)


[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Camera performance and motions bug fixes


[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
- Game doesn’t restart
- Walls building has various bugs
- When walls are closed, floor is not creating
- Furnitures are not rotatable
